children: ) will host an investor event showcasing our Global Specialty Lines ("GSL") business on Tuesday, December 8, 2026. Formal presentations by senior executives will begin at 9:00 a.m. ET and are expected to conclude at approximately 11:30 a.m. ET.

Charles Brindamour, Chief Executive Officer, will be joined by Emmanuel Clarke, Chief Executive Officer of GSL, and other senior executives to provide insights into the strengths and capabilities of our GSL business and how it leverages Intact's competitive advantages.
A link to access the live webcast is available in the
section of Intact Financial Corporation's website. The audio replay will be available following the event.

) is a global provider of property and casualty insurance founded on core values and a belief that insurance is about people, not things. Intact's success is fueled by its 32,000 employees worldwide who embody the company's purpose: to help people, businesses and society prosper in good times and be resilient in bad times. To achieve its ambitions, Intact seeks to ensure customers are its advocates, its people are engaged, and the company is one of the most respected.

Intact is the largest provider of property and casualty insurance in Canada and has successfully exported its strengths across North America, the UK, and Europe. Its growing commercial and specialty solutions network now spans over 170 countries. With a customer-driven mindset, Intact has expanded its operations to include insurance distribution, restoration, and prevention.

Intact solidifies its outperformance by leveraging its competitive advantages: global leadership in data and AI for pricing and risk selection; deep claims expertise and integrated supply chain network; and strong capital and investment management. Intact's total annual operating Direct Premiums Written has tripled over the last decade to $25 billion.
